subject: AtlasGuard incident — request for service restitution authorization
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@atlasguard.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlasguard.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: request for compensation after 7/8 inference outage

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the postmortem yesterday — appreciate the thorough timeline. AtlasGuard experienced elevated error rates and significant token throttling during the 7/8 incident window (2025-07-08 02:40–03:55 UTC). Our legal and finance teams are asking for an official calculation for service restitution and an expected timeline for credit issuance.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether this qualifies under Redwood's SLA for uptime/throughput remediation?
- If eligible, what is the proposed credit amount and timing (invoice adjustment or account credit)?
- We need evidence pack: uptime table, per-token counts for the affected window, and the credit calculation workbook.

We'd like to close this on our side before the next billing cycle (next invoice closes 2025-07-25). Please advise next steps and who from Redwood will sign off.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Patel
Head of Infrastructure & Ops | AtlasGuard
samira.patel@atlasguard.com
[Attachment: incident_timeline_7-8.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@atlasguard.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: request for compensation after 7/8 inference outage

Hi Samira — thanks for flagging and for the details. We're treating this as an SLA remediation request and will prioritize.

Action plan (short):
1) I'll gather approvals for an initial credit authorization from finance and ops today.
2) Marissa will run the usage reconciliation and produce a preliminary credit calc (attached).
3) We'll return a final authorization and DocuSign-ready statement by EOD Thursday 7/17 with the evidence bundle you requested.

As a note, standard remediation flows are invoice adjustment on the next billing cycle unless customer requests an immediate account credit. Which do you prefer?

Cc'ing Marissa and Lauren for the calc and sign-off.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
[phone ext: 7421]
[Attachment: — placeholder for internal credit calc request sheet]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: request for compensation after 7/8 inference outage — preliminary calc

Stephanie / Lauren — attaching the preliminary calc and evidence extracts. Highlights:
- Affected window: 2025-07-08 02:40–03:55 UTC (matches AtlasGuard report).
- Total billed tokens during window: 1,248,300 tokens.
- Hourly throughput degradation: median latency spike and 42% reduced completion rate for the period; qualifies under our latency/throughput SLO for partial remediation.
- Preliminary credit (pro-rata uptime method): $6,820. Calculation notes in tab 'readme'.

Attachments included: atlasguard_prelim_credit_calc_v1.xlsx (calc + data pulls), evidence_snippets.csv (extracted logs). I recommend we route for Finance approval; Connor can confirm the payout method (invoice adjustment vs account credit) and timing.

Connor — can you confirm whether we have any pre-existing credit ceilings for ATG under ATG-4592? If not, I'll proceed to finalize with a recommended make-good amount of $6,820 and prepare the formal memo.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: atlasguard_prelim_credit_calc_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@atlasguard.com>, Procurement <procurement@atlasguard.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: AtlasGuard — approved restitution and issuance path (final)

Hi Samira — following our internal review, Redwood has approved the remediation amount. Summary and next steps below.

Summary:
- Final authorized credit: $6,820 USD (pro-rata uptime methodology; see attached summary).
- Evidence bundle attached: incident timeline, token extraction, and final calc (atlasguard_final_credit_summary.pdf).
- Payout method: invoice adjustment on next invoice cycle (we can issue an account credit instead if you prefer — please confirm).

Next steps / timeline:
1) Please confirm method (invoice adjustment vs immediate account credit) by 2025-07-20 — if no reply, we'll apply the invoice adjustment on billing close 2025-07-25.
2) We'll send a short remediation memo for signature via DocuSign (link below). Execution of that document is required to complete the payout.
3) Once signed and processed, credit posts on the following invoice (typically 1 billing cycle after sign-off).

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/XYZ-ATG-2025
Attached: atlasguard_final_credit_summary.pdf (pdf, 58 KB)

If procurement wants a line-item breakdown for accounting, Marissa can provide the CSV export.

Thanks for your partnership — apologies again for the disruption. Please let me or Marissa know which payout method you prefer.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
[Attachment: atlasguard_final_credit_summary.pdf (pdf, 58 KB)]
